title: Video
lede: Embed a video with built-in playback controls and lazy loading support.

examples.heading: Default
No Loop
No Controls
Controls
examples.description: The control bar once the video can play (a client-only state): a 48px bar at rest, transparent until the pointer moves over the player. The play button, the elapsed time, the scrubber (a drag area over the progress bar, with the handle that the reference's peer rule never shows) and the duration. The class strings come from the component's client code; the server HTML renders the frame and the video only.
